components.name: Vendor Proprietary RTOS Base Layer
components.description: 벤더 자체 개발 실시간 운영체제 계층. 폐쇄형이며 공개 소스 구성요소를 최소화한다.

components.name: wolfSSL
components.description: 실시간 제어기용 소형 TLS 라이브러리. 인증서 검증과 세션 암호화를 수행한다.

components.name: Treck TCP/IP Stack
components.description: 상용 임베디드 TCP/IP 스택. 계측 장비의 이더넷 통신 계층을 구성한다.

components.name: lwIP
components.description: 경량 TCP/IP 스택. 소형 제어기의 Modbus/TCP 및 진단 웹 통신 경로를 담당한다.

components.name: Mbed TLS
components.description: MCU 급 장비를 위한 경량 TLS 스택. 클라우드 및 게이트웨이 연결을 암호화한다.

components.name: zlib
components.description: 펌웨어 이미지와 로그 압축/해제에 사용되는 무손실 압축 라이브러리.

components.name: OpenSSL
components.description: TLS/SSL 및 범용 암호 라이브러리. 장비의 보안 통신 채널과 인증서 처리를 담당한다.

components.name: NTP Daemon
components.description: 이벤트 타임스탬프 정합성을 위한 시각 동기화 데몬.

components.name: MicroSmart Embedded Web Configuration UI
components.description: 브라우저 기반 설정 및 상태 조회 화면을 제공하는 내장 웹 애플리케이션.

components.name: MicroSmart Configuration Store Service
components.description: 프로젝트 설정, 태그 정의, 사용자 계정 정보를 영구 저장하고 무결성을 검증하는 서비스.

components.name: MicroSmart Time Synchronization Service
components.description: NTP/PTP 기반 시각 동기화와 이벤트 타임스탬프 정합성을 유지하는 서비스.

components.name: MicroSmart Firmware Update Agent
components.description: 서명 검증을 포함한 펌웨어 이미지 수신, 검증, 활성화 절차를 수행하는 업데이트 에이전트.

components.name: Modbus/TCP Protocol Stack
components.description: Modbus TCP 서버/클라이언트 기능. 레지스터 및 코일 접근 요청을 처리한다.

components.name: BACnet/IP Stack
components.description: 건물 자동화 객체 모델과 COV 구독을 처리하는 BACnet/IP 스택.

vulnerabilities.description: The Treck TCP/IP stack before 6.0.1.66 allows Remote Code Execution, related to IPv4 tunneling.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: The Treck TCP/IP stack before 5.0.1.35 has an Out-of-Bounds Write via multiple malformed IPv6 packets.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: Buffer overflow in the decodearr function in ntpq in ntp 4.2.8p6 through 4.2.8p10 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by leveraging an ntpq query and sending a response with a crafted array.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: zlib through 1.2.12 has a heap-based buffer over-read or buffer overflow in inflate in inflate.c via a large gzip header extra field. NOTE: only applications that call inflateGetHeader are affected. Some common applications bundle the affected zlib source code but may be unable to call inflateGetHeader (e.g., see the nodejs/node reference).

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: The Treck TCP/IP stack before 6.0.1.66 allows Remote Code execution via a single invalid DNS response.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: zlib before 1.2.12 allows memory corruption when deflating (i.e., when compressing) if the input has many distant matches.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: The ctl_getitem method in ntpd in ntp-4.2.8p6 before 4.2.8p11 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (out-of-bounds read) via a crafted mode 6 packet with a ntpd instance from 4.2.8p6 through 4.2.8p10.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: ntpd in ntp 4.2.8p4 before 4.2.8p11 drops bad packets before updating the "received" timestamp, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (disruption) by sending a packet with a zero-origin timestamp causing the association to reset and setting the contents of the packet as the most recent timestamp. This issue is a result of an incomplete fix for CVE-2015-7704.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: A buffer overflow vulnerability in the icmp6_send_response_with_addrs_and_netif() function of Free Software Foundation lwIP version git head allows attackers to access sensitive information via a crafted ICMPv6 packet.
